We develop innovative medical technologies that effectively detect, diagnose and treat health
conditions and raise the standard of care globally.

We know women face unique health challenges at every stage of life, and we are passionate about
being a force for good.

[ Learn about Hologic ][118]

## Careers

Hologic is propelled by the passion and courage of our people to make a difference and innovate in
all we do. We believe everyone should feel welcomed, valued and heard, because great ideas come from
a diversity of views and experiences. We are proud to create opportunities for those who want to
grow their careers while making the world a better, healthier place.

  Business Solutions
  
  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

  Business Solutions
  
  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

We specialize in providing affordable financial products and services for people and businesses in
low-to-moderate income and marginalized communities.

CDFI stands for Community Development Financial Institution. It means we’re designed to make loans
in communities mainstream lenders often overlook—and to work with you, not just your credit score.

Financial assistance and support may be available for first-time homebuyers—or for those who haven’t
owned a home in the last 3 years.

chances before you apply.

][77] [

# Culture Diagnostics, Simplified

From collection to culture, making it easier to do your best work

[ SHOP ALL PRODUCTS ][37]

## Shop by Category

## Clinical Microbiology

Reliable culture-based solutions for HAI detection, routine screening, and pathogen identification.

## [Explore products][38]

## Veterinary Microbiology

Prepared culture media and self-contained diagnostic devices for efficient in-clinic and field
testing.

## [Explore products][39]

## Food & Environmental Microbiology

Pre-plated media and all-in-one diagnostic solutions designed for sample collection, transport, and
analysis—whether in the field, a processing facility, or the lab.

## [Explore products][40]

## Time-Tested, Diagnostics-Proven

For clinicians, veterinarians, and laboratory professionals, our InTray® and InPouch® systems
streamline sample collection, incubation, and pathogen detection into a self-contained format,
reducing contamination risk and eliminating unnecessary transfers.

## InTray®

A self-contained culture system that integrates specimen collection, selective media incubation, and
direct microscopic analysis—all within a sealed cassette. Designed for point-of-care and laboratory
use, InTray® minimizes handling while enabling reliable pathogen identification.

[ LEARN MORE ][41]

## InPouch®

A resealable culture-based diagnostic system combining sample collection, transport, incubation, and
microscopic observation in one device. InPouch® is engineered for clinical, veterinary, and
field-based testing, providing a safe, efficient, and contamination-resistant alternative to
traditional culture.

### Welcome to Brunel. 

Behind every major project are people most of us never see. The engineers, technicians, project
leaders and technical specialists powering the electricity in our homes, the materials we depend on,
the infrastructure that connects us, and the essential industries we depend on every day.


For over[50 years][48], Brunel has helped the world's leading businesses find and mobilise
specialist talent for some of the most critical projects and industries on the planet, wherever, and
whenever, they're needed.

Whether you're delivering a major project, scaling operations across borders, or solving your next
workforce challenge, our global recruitment specialists are here to help you find the people who
make it possible.

# CHALLENGE TB

September 4, 2019

## [Challenge TB Closeout][1]

[india]After 5 years of work, the Challenge TB project is coming to a close.

 
To highlight the impact of the project and to celebrate its achievements, a closeout event will be
held at the Union Conference in Hyderabad, India.

 
The event will be chaired by Prof. Frank Cobelens – Professor of Epidemiology and Control of
Poverty-Related Infectious Diseases, University of Amsterdam and Dr. Tereza Kasaeva – Director of
the World Health Organization Global TB Program.

May 15, 2019

## [Technical Briefs][2]

[brief]Challenge TB has developed numerous implementation and technical briefs which highlight the
project’s technical approaches, results, and lessons from our work in TB across 23 countries over
the last 5 years.

 

In order to share the project’s experiences and insights with as wide an audience as possible, these
technical documents are all available to [download][3], allowing everyone to learn about our impact,
and continue the fight to end the TB epidemic.

December 12, 2018

## [New Guide on Drug-Safety Monitoring][4]

[aDSM]With recent developments in drug-resistant TB (DR-TB) treatment, particularly the approval for
use of the new drugs, bedaquiline and delamanid ahead of the completion of Phase III trials, there
is a need for early and systematic detection, management, recording, and reporting of any adverse
events that may occur in patients who are prescribed these medications.

 
To meet this need we have published a new guide on [Active drug safety monitoring and management
(aDSM)][5].

 
This technical guidance document introduces the concept of aDSM for new drugs and regimens used in
the treatment of drug-resistant TB patients, outlines the definitions related to aDSM, the agreed
essential activities, and the key steps in implementing aDSM in patients on treatment.

to share with you. We will share tips, insight, guidelines, words of wisdom, fun facts, audios,

By Jim Humble (1932-2023)
July 24, 2026

First facts, MMS does not kill friendly bacteria. What is the difference in useful bacteria and the
harmful stuff? Well the feces of the useful bacteria is not poisonous and the feces of the harmful
bacteria is poisonous and that is what makes one sick and causes the problems.

Poisons have long chains of atoms and molecules. It is easy to break the chain and destroy the
poison. With chlorine dioxide present the poisonous chain is oxidized, but since the chain is coming
from the body of the pathogen it can be oxidized before it is all the way out...

Jim: In regards to your question about plastics, we really cannot give you a “sure bet” answer. This
is because the world of plastics is vast, and like so many things in our environment, it’s difficult
to know what is really what. To give you an idea, a University of Texas Study published in

plastics, even BPA-free plastics.

July 5, 2026

Jim: Antibacterial drugs can sometimes stop bacterial [infections] diseases but medicine has yet to
develop anything to stop viral infections. Thankfully, MMS/CD has been known to stop both viral and
bacterial diseases. For either viral or bacterial infections, begin with the Starting Procedure and
continue following the Health Recovery Plan (always observing the Three Golden Rules) until well.
(Note: The Health Recovery Plan is outlined in detail in the ).

In the case of viral or bacterial diseases on the skin, use the MMS1 or the MMS2 spray bottle, (see

By Jim Humble (1932-2023)
June 27, 2026

Every week at least one new person approaches me with the question will MMS/CD help overcome some
new disease. MMS/CD is an oxidizer that fits into the operation of the body in the exact right
chemical balance to kill diseases and their poisons and eradicate heavy metals. Drugs must somehow
attack the nucleus of the disease in order to kill it and they often never do the job, but the
MMS/CD oxidizer just attacks the pathogen. Pathogens have no protection for oxidizers and no way of
developing a protection. There are thousands of diseases with names someone has given them...

We specialize in providing affordable financial products and services for people and businesses in
low-to-moderate income and marginalized communities.

[Open an account][74]

## How Can We Help You Today?

[

### Credit Union + CDFI

CDFI stands for Community Development Financial Institution. It means we’re designed to make loans
in communities mainstream lenders often overlook—and to work with you, not just your credit score.

][75] [

# Culture Diagnostics, Simplified

From collection to culture, making it easier to do your best work

[ SHOP ALL PRODUCTS ][37]

## Shop by Category

## Clinical Microbiology

Reliable culture-based solutions for HAI detection, routine screening, and pathogen identification.

## [Explore products][38]

## Veterinary Microbiology

Prepared culture media and self-contained diagnostic devices for efficient in-clinic and field
testing.

## [Explore products][39]

## Food & Environmental Microbiology

Pre-plated media and all-in-one diagnostic solutions designed for sample collection, transport, and
analysis—whether in the field, a processing facility, or the lab.

## [Explore products][40]

## Time-Tested, Diagnostics-Proven

For clinicians, veterinarians, and laboratory professionals, our InTray® and InPouch® systems
streamline sample collection, incubation, and pathogen detection into a self-contained format,
reducing contamination risk and eliminating unnecessary transfers.

## InTray®

A self-contained culture system that integrates specimen collection, selective media incubation, and
direct microscopic analysis—all within a sealed cassette. Designed for point-of-care and laboratory
use, InTray® minimizes handling while enabling reliable pathogen identification.

[ LEARN MORE ][41]

## InPouch®

A resealable culture-based diagnostic system combining sample collection, transport, incubation, and
microscopic observation in one device. InPouch® is engineered for clinical, veterinary, and
field-based testing, providing a safe, efficient, and contamination-resistant alternative to
traditional culture.

# CHALLENGE TB

September 4, 2019

## [Challenge TB Closeout][1]

[india]After 5 years of work, the Challenge TB project is coming to a close.

 
To highlight the impact of the project and to celebrate its achievements, a closeout event will be
held at the Union Conference in Hyderabad, India.

 
The event will be chaired by Prof. Frank Cobelens – Professor of Epidemiology and Control of
Poverty-Related Infectious Diseases, University of Amsterdam and Dr. Tereza Kasaeva – Director of
the World Health Organization Global TB Program.

May 15, 2019

## [Technical Briefs][2]

[brief]Challenge TB has developed numerous implementation and technical briefs which highlight the
project’s technical approaches, results, and lessons from our work in TB across 23 countries over
the last 5 years.

 

In order to share the project’s experiences and insights with as wide an audience as possible, these
technical documents are all available to [download][3], allowing everyone to learn about our impact,
and continue the fight to end the TB epidemic.

December 12, 2018

## [New Guide on Drug-Safety Monitoring][4]

[aDSM]With recent developments in drug-resistant TB (DR-TB) treatment, particularly the approval for
use of the new drugs, bedaquiline and delamanid ahead of the completion of Phase III trials, there
is a need for early and systematic detection, management, recording, and reporting of any adverse
events that may occur in patients who are prescribed these medications.

 
To meet this need we have published a new guide on [Active drug safety monitoring and management
(aDSM)][5].

 
This technical guidance document introduces the concept of aDSM for new drugs and regimens used in
the treatment of drug-resistant TB patients, outlines the definitions related to aDSM, the agreed
essential activities, and the key steps in implementing aDSM in patients on treatment.
